description: Durable, database-owned continuation state: CANA remembers what must happen later, knows what it is waiting for, and wakes missions by time, event, condition, dependency, follow-up, revalidation or learning triggers. External runtimes tick it; none of them own it.
real_outcome: A conversation ending, a model failing, or a machine restarting never erases a future mission.
reversibility: Triggers cancel/expire; receipts are append-only and hash-chained (deliberately not erasable).

canonical_actions.description: Create a bounded trigger (rejected without purpose/stop/budget/ceiling/expiry, or when aggregate trigger allocation exceeds the mission ceiling)
